# sqlpipe v2.0

**Breaking change:** the `name` field on `/v2/users` has been split into `first_name` and `last_name`. Requests that send `name` will be rejected, and responses no longer include it. Update any client that reads or writes `name` before upgrading; if you need a single display string, join the two fields on your side.

**New:** the `--incremental` flag. When set, sqlpipe transfers only rows that have changed since the last successful run instead of reloading the full source table, which cuts sync time substantially on large, slow-changing tables.

**Performance:** Parquet writes are about 40% faster. This applies automatically to existing pipelines with no configuration changes; output files are byte-compatible with those produced by v1.
